semanticOwner: CanonicalCapabilityCatalogSnapshot owns one eager immutable selector publication and its ResolutionToken-bound global IC, nullable default, workflow authorability, per-IC number, AB IC, and AB topology facts. CanonicalCapabilityExperience exposes that publication; compiler and selector disclosure share one Application topology projection. WorkflowSessionPresentationViewModel owns validated page-local Merge and Replace drafts, exact-target workflow filtering, notification order, deterministic reconciliation, atomic destination activation, and inspection projection reuse only when the typed context permits it. MergePresentationViewModel alone owns AB same-TP/link, slot, inspection, readiness, plan, path, and output state. Application remains the sole capability-readiness and output-naming semantic owner; Presentation uses nullable or empty no-selection display state rather than fabricating either fact.
terminalContract: Each catalog snapshot constructs one eager immutable selector publication before atomic publication; every selector fact observed during one refresh carries that same ResolutionToken and an older publication remains immutable. A valid zero-authorable publication has a null default and fails closed without invoking profile-dependent authoring queries. A transient null or empty TwoWay value cannot replace a valid page draft. On refresh or direct page open, Presentation obtains exactly one selector publication, reconciles Merge and Replace independently, publishes ItemsSource before SelectedItem, and only then rebuilds active-page slots/readiness/inspection. Every Home draft is filtered by its exact workflow and each aggregate Merge/Replace entry is enabled only while at least one workflow on that page remains authorable. If a retained IC loses one workflow, only that workflow's draft/entry is withdrawn; if removed globally, use the same-publication nullable default without changing the other page draft. Removing the active AB topology repairs the number choice from the same publication without hanging. Zero AB closes and clears an open Home AB draft and disables entry; a later publication can re-enable it. Activation or refresh never borrows another page's slots, AB link, inspection generation/revision, readiness, plan, paths, or output state. A missing projection, a mismatched token, or a tokenless Standard Merge, AB Merge, DP Replace, or CtrlRAM Replace projection is stale and must be reinspected; the General Replace discovery-only Base projection is the sole tokenless reuse exception while its typed inspection context remains Base-only. Stale catalog or inspection completion cannot overwrite a newer selector publication. With no selected IC, Presentation returns nullable capability readiness, localized unavailable readiness text, and empty Standard/AB/General Merge and Replace output-name identity instead of inventing Application-owned facts. Generic binding notification cannot create duplicate user activity; only an actual selected IC or number value transition emits that activity. The NT51950 typed cascade choice retains ChipCount 2 and DisplayLabel 2 IC; linked TPA/TPB can round-trip Merge -> Replace -> Merge without an unhandled exception or cross-page state publication. No firmware bytes, ranges, operations, processors, naming, Golden evidence, or formal support change.

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 architecture review approved one eager immutable Application selector publication with a nullable default, a shared topology projection, one selector-publication acquisition per refresh, ItemsSource-before-SelectedItem ordering, independent Merge/Replace repair, exact-target workflow filtering for every Home draft and aggregate page entry, zero-global fail-closed behavior, catalog-bound tokenless projections treated as stale, General Replace discovery-only Base as the sole tokenless exception under its Base-only typed inspection contract, nullable/empty no-selection Presentation state, and no Domain/Infrastructure/Profile/firmware changes. Approval is conditional on removing historical overlapping backfill records and admitting every new path before production edits.
